submission.bindingBasis: Owner reported that the Workspace source identity advanced after planning. The planning-time evidence (head 4e6ce637...) and sourceStateDigest may be stale. Per the owner contract, workspace.close may compare-and-close one exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and a mismatch fails not_committed. Since the boundary evidence indicates the source identity changed, I cannot safely apply the planning-time binding without re-observing the current source state via workspace.get first.
submission.rationale: The owner explicitly reports that Workspace source identity advanced after planning. This invalidates the planning-time sourceStateDigest and head revision as binding evidence for a close operation. The workspace.close contract permits compare-and-close only against an exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and a mismatch fails not_committed. Re-observing via workspace.get to learn the current head revision and exact sourceStateDigest before attempting close is the correct path, rather than risking a not_committed failure or acting unbound on stale evidence.
